name: What is the process for starting a room expansion project with Frasheski Construction?

mainEntity.name: What is the process for starting a room expansion project with Frasheski Construction?

acceptedAnswer.text: The process begins with an initial consultation where we discuss your vision, needs, and budget. We then proceed to a design phase, developing plans and securing necessary permits. Once approved, the construction phase starts, involving demolition, framing, utility rough-ins, and finishing work. Throughout the project, we maintain clear communication and manage all aspects to ensure a smooth progression. Our approach ensures transparency and addresses any questions or adjustments promptly.
acceptedAnswer.description: Our process starts with consultation, moves to design and permits, then construction, with continuous communication throughout. We manage all project aspects.
